trees.name: python3.12-stdlib
trees.why: stdlib the retained test/docs/accept scripts import (lzma, sqlite3, ctypes, unittest ...); python locates it relative to its own prefix

trees.name: poudriere-share
trees.why: poudriere SCRIPTPREFIX, found from realpath(bin/poudriere); MANIFESTS (absolute symlink to /usr/local/share/freebsd/MANIFESTS, used by jail creation, not by `image`) is not captured

trees.name: poudriere-libexec
trees.why: poudriere LIBEXECPREFIX helpers (timeout, lockf, nc, sh ...)

ambient.name: poudriere-etc
ambient.why: POUDRIERE_ETC: poudriere.conf plus jail and ports-tree registry (JAIL 16r2303b36, PTREE daports141)

ambient.name: jail-kernel
ambient.why: poudriere image hybridiso requires a jail with a kernel

ambient.name: jail-libc
ambient.why: anchor for the jail root; the whole jail root is not hashable without root (UNKNOWN full-tree identity)

ambient.name: package-catalogue
ambient.why: signed-free repository catalogue of the bulk package set build-iso.sh collects from; it carries each package's digest

ambient.name: package-set-listing
ambient.why: names and sizes only: 1470 packages (8.1 GB) are not content-hashed, so this is a weak identity (UNKNOWN per-package bytes beyond the catalogue)

ambient.name: set-base
ambient.why: SET_CACHE_DIR release sets the jail was made from

ambient.name: secureboot-bundle
ambient.why: SECUREBOOT_BUNDLE (public, already signed artifact; hashed only)

ambient.name: secureboot-certificate
ambient.why: SECUREBOOT_CERTIFICATE (public material; hashed only, content not read for display)
